name: Foundry: Crack Floor
design_intent:
FOUNDRY: CRACK FLOOR — THE FOUNDRY circuit's LIVE-erosion brawl (tier 2; brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 Foundry row 12). Each of the three islands starts as a full deck but its OUTER halves are destructible molten slag that ERODES away on a telegraphed timed schedule, so within ~5s each island shrinks to a narrow permanent CORE — footing is progressively lost and the fight climbs into the air (boost to survive). Unlike the collapse finales, this NEVER fully strands a player: a permanent trampoline core survives at each island's center (GI-1 safe by construction), so every required crossing always has a landing. Single-family (destructible) mid-intensity. Tier 2.

DOCTRINE FIT (destructibles are SURFACES, not contact hazards — the void/fall is the killer): (1) each island = a permanent central trampoline CORE (w300) flanked by two destructible slag blocks (w300 each) that erode edges-first. (2) TELEGRAPHY — every slag block shows growing CRACKS + a SHUDDER + a hazard-red flash for telegraph_s 1.0s BEFORE it vanishes; you SEE the footing shrink and retreat toward the core. (3) FAIRNESS/GI-1 — all six flank blocks erode on the SAME symmetric schedule (break_time 5.0s); the three permanent cores + their 680px flight gaps are UNTOUCHED, so the arena can never reach a stranded/unwinnable state; spawns on the cores. (4) CREDIT — a fall into the void = uncredited self-fall (killer=-1); a rival smashed off just before/after a block breaks is credited within the 6.0s ring-out window.

GEOMETRY (void_is_floor): three islands over ONE full-width void, each = LEFT slag (destructible) + CENTER core (permanent) + RIGHT slag (destructible), all top y1080, trampoline: A cores x300..600 (slag x0..300, x600..900) / B core x1880..2180 (slag x1580..1880, x2180..2480) / C core x3460..3760 (slag x3160..3460, x3760..4060). Full-island edges sit 680px apart over the void (pre-erosion); after erosion the cores stand alone. Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>=650px recovery sky; outer edges 610px inside side blast lines). Molten open_sky (clouds off, horizon glow).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px => ~395px zero-boost drift; max spring drift ~527px; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (full-island edges x900..x1580 = 680px over void, WIDENING to ~1280px core-to-core as the slag erodes): > 527 and >> 395 at all times. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px, widening similarly): NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- SURVIVE the erosion: as the slag flanks vanish, footing shrinks to the cores and the fight forces more air time; retreat toward a core on each block's 1.0s telegraph. The erosion NEVER removes a required landing (the cores are permanent) and never creates a bounce path across a gap. Verb: DODGE/FLY.
- Zero-boost off any core reaches NO other surface across the gap: flight is REQUIRED; the erosion reshapes the fight, the permanent cores keep every crossing completable.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the Foundry's live-shrinking brawl that stays completable (foundry_meltdown/cascade/collapse_ring fully erode as finales; this keeps permanent cores). One-line read: 'the slag melts out from under you — hold the shrinking cores and knock rivals into the widening pit.'
